name: Un seul jeu
storyline:
As night falls, the Griffophone suddenly shuts down, and a single sheet of paper escapes into the darkness. Carried by the wind, the mysterious sheet begins a long journey through a world where all of Algator37's games and creations have merged into one continuous universe.

The player controls the flying sheet with one simple rule: hold to rise and release to glide. Across the night, the sheet travels through ten different environments, including the Griffophone's hideout, rainy rooftops, a strange doodle factory, a block-based world, a towering ascent, an arena, a live-streaming world, a mysterious multiverse, Douza's cave, and finally the player's home.

Along the way, the sheet can collect 25 hidden drawings representing characters and creations from the Griffophone universe. Different characters appear throughout the journey, watching the sheet fly overhead and reacting to its passage.

The journey is also a race against time. As the night progresses toward dawn, the player must manage their limited breath, use air currents, avoid the environment, and maintain control long enough to reach the illuminated window waiting at home.

There are no separate levels or changing controls: the entire adventure is one uninterrupted flight. Every world, character, drawing, and obstacle is part of the same continuous journey.

The ultimate goal is to make it home before sunrise while bringing as many drawings back as possible. Collect all 25, and the Griffophone finally reveals the meaning of the journey: during this strange night, every game was really just one single game.
summary:
Griffophone – Un Seul Jeu is a minimalist atmospheric flying game where the player controls a single sheet of paper traveling through a continuous world inspired by the games and creations of the Algator37 universe.

The objective is simple: keep the sheet in the air by holding a single button, using the wind, gravity, air currents, and the terrain to control its flight. Release the button to glide and recover your breath, then rise again when necessary.

The journey takes place across ten interconnected areas, each with its own atmosphere and environmental characteristics, including a hideout, rainy rooftops, a factory, a block-based world, a tower, an arena, a livestream studio, a multiverse, a cave, and finally home.

Along the way, players can discover and collect 25 drawings representing characters and elements from the Griffophone and Algator37 universe. Each discovery becomes part of a collection that can be completed over multiple flights.

The game features a dynamic night-to-dawn cycle, procedural world generation, changing weather and air currents, atmospheric visuals, original ambient sound, persistent collection progress, and a simple one-button control system.

The ultimate goal is to make it home before dawn while collecting as many drawings as possible. Find all 25 drawings and complete the journey to discover the full Griffophone experience.
